rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization annual maximum allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: Landlords may raise rent only once a year, by no more than the lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change. The maximum allowable increase for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 is 2.87%.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 2.87% for 9/1/2026-8/31/2027
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; this page does not state building-age, unit-count, or owner-type coverage limits.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: The page does not state coverage criteria or exemptions. Readers should check the ordinance itself for which units are covered.

rules.penalty: Tenants may file a Tenant Petition to contest increases above the maximum allowed.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.conflict_note: The page gives no official municipal code citation and no effective date. The 2.87% figure applies to the period 9/1/2026-8/31/2027. Coverage limits, such as Costa-Hawkins exclusions, are not described on this page.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict, such as nonpayment of rent, a lease violation, or owner move-in. For certain eviction reasons, landlords may have to pay relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; this page does not state coverage limits.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: The page does not state coverage criteria, exemptions, or the full list of just causes. Readers should check the ordinance itself.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.conflict_note: This is a summary page with no official code citation and no effective date. The relocation assistance amount is not stated.
